title: The Old Mill of {locality}
description: The millrace has fallen quiet. Follow the split oak and the kingfisher bend to the old mill above {locality}. You can retreat or save at any safe moment.
return_text: The millrace sings again. {locality} thanks you.
retreat_text: You return to {locality}. Your discoveries and opened routes are remembered.
defeat_text: The trail keeper brings your party back to the split oak. Rested and safe, you can try again; your discoveries remain.

objectives.text: Follow the landmarks to the mill entrance. Read the miller's ledger inside.

rooms.name: The Kingfisher Trail
rooms.description: A split oak marks the old wagon road. Beyond the kingfisher bend, a roof peeks out of the riverside trees.

actions.label: Read the trail carving
actions.text: The split oak bears a wheel carving: follow the broad path north for the mill. The thin western trail was the miller's quiet fishing spot.

actions.label: Listen at the river bend
actions.text: A kingfisher waits on a branch. The water is still: the mill's sluice must be closed.

actions.label: Enter the Old Mill
actions.text: The timber doorway opens into the receiving room.

rooms.name: Receiving Room
rooms.description: Wagon tracks end at a worn weighing scale. A ledger lies beside dry sacks and a keeper's resting bench.

actions.label: Leave by the wagon door
actions.text: You step back onto the Kingfisher Trail.

actions.label: Read the miller's ledger
actions.text: The last entry reads: 'Store the spare handle with the grain. Fit it at the wheel, then open the sluice. Never force the root-choked heart while the race is dry.'

actions.label: Rest at the keeper's bench
actions.text: At the sheltered bench, your party rests. HP, MP and conditions are restored.
